india_trends.title: Mechanical Turk: Why is Amazon shutting down crowdsourced work platform which jeff bezos called Artificial AI?
india_trends.summary: Amazon is shutting down Mechanical Turk, its crowdsourced work platform, on 30 September, 2026. Launched in 2005, the service connected workers with tasks such as data labelling and surveys, but faced declining investment, growing competition, and questions over data quality.
